UserCloudProfile.title: UserCloudProfile
UserCloudProfile.description: Authenticated user's private Caller ID preferences and opt-in community sync stats.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Display name for the user profile (1-80 chars).

callerIdEnabled.description: Whether live cloud Caller ID lookup is enabled.

communityShareEnabled.description: Whether the user opted in to share contact names with the NovaCall community directory.

sharedContactCount.description: Number of contact names synced by this user (0-5000).

CallerDirectoryEntry.title: CallerDirectoryEntry
CallerDirectoryEntry.description: Shared community Caller ID record keyed by canonical normalized phone digits (e.g., 8801712345678).

phoneKey.description: Canonical digits-only phone key (4-15 digits) matching document ID.

carrierLabel.description: Detected carrier or region label (0-60 chars).

spamReports.description: Count of spam reports for this number.

reportCount.description: Total community verifications/tags for this number.

contributedByUid.description: UID of the user who originally contributed this entry.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user settings and opt-in Caller ID sync profile, restricted to owner UID.

/caller_directory/{phoneKey}.description: Community Caller ID directory supporting exact phone-key lookup and authenticated contributions.
